description: Experimental. Puts 2-5 saved characters into one situation as strangers and starts a scene. Each round every character, in turn, thinks (feelings toward each other, what they want to say, hide or ask) and then speaks, acts or stays silent. Returns the director's protocol, the first speaker and their packet; record each turn with character_meet_turn.

characters.description: Ids of saved characters, in the order they enter.

events.description: Planned sudden changes everyone perceives, each at the start of its round.

max_rounds.description: When the scene stops at the latest.

situation.description: The user's situation, in English: a place, and any details they gave (time, roles, what is going on).

tasks.description: One task per character (see the protocol).

task.description: Why they are here right now and what they need, in English. Only this character learns it.

name: character_meet
title: Characters meet (experimental)
